description: An unofficial, drop-in Trakt plugin fork with per-user self-service and optional, administrator-controlled integration for other applications.
name: Better Trakt
overview: Trakt sync with user self-service and Foreseer integration

versions.changelog: Adds the public Trakt client ID to the administrator-controlled Foreseer token bridge. No Trakt client secret or refresh token is exposed.

First Better Trakt release.

- Drop-in replacement for the official Jellyfin Trakt plugin.
- Preserves the existing plugin GUID, Trakt.dll assembly, /Trakt routes, and Trakt.xml configuration.
- Adds per-user Trakt authorization and preference self-service.
- Adds optional administrator-controlled access-token export for Foreseer and other integrations.
- Includes current upstream Jellyfin Trakt fixes for Jellyfin 10.11.

Do not run Better Trakt and the official Trakt plugin together.
